Key Takeaways
Lead generation strategy was emphasized with a focus on improving conversion rates via refined landing page designs and prioritizing US, Canada, and Australia markets.
Technical SEO issues such as mobile performance scores and shipping schema errors were reviewed with action items assigned for further optimization.
ANZ ecommerce blog topics are to be shared urgently by the end of day to support next month’s content revamp.
Next steps include tracking lead conversions in GA4, scheduling a follow-up call for UI/UX updates, and finalizing the overall content and SEO improvement plan.
Improvements to product engineering services pages were discussed, including the addition of secondary keywords and query-focused content to strengthen SEO.

Content Reviewed
PES cornerstone block confirmed ready with images to be added; sheet reviewed by Shiresha.
Data queries and traffic analysis from August and September (lead form filter) were shared for deeper analysis.
Google Analytics report showed weekly traffic between 700 and 900 sessions with corresponding lead numbers.
Overall content plan was discussed including fintech, product engineering services, Salesforce pages, and upcoming ecommerce content.
A document detailing UI/UX changes and suggested improvements has been shared and is pending further discussion.
Target Keywords
Focus on fintech and product engineering service keywords with pillar page content, and exploration of geo-specific programmatic pages.
Discussion on adding secondary keywords for tech stack pages such as .NET and React JS to enrich landing page content.
Metrics
Weekly traffic is measured at 700-900 sessions with an average of 2-2.5 leads per week.
Qualified lead conversion rate stands at approximately 25% from the traffic pool.
Core Web Vitals show desktop performance around 90, while mobile scores are low (noted as 2.22) with a target above 80.
SEO Recommendations
Revamp landing pages to boost lead conversion rates and enhance user interlinking.
Accelerate publication of blog topics for the ANZ ecommerce vertical with specific content planning.
Incorporate additional secondary keywords and FAQ sections in product engineering service pages for better search intent alignment.
Address structured data issues to correct shipping details in product schema for ecommerce pages.
Competitors
Content Refresh Opportunities
Complete updates on Salesforce pages and plan an ecommerce landing page revamp next month.
Evaluate tech stack pages (e.g., .NET, React JS) for potential dedicated content to drive additional keyword traffic.
Refresh product engineering service pages by adding secondary keywords and FAQ sections for deeper content framework.
Lead Generation Strategies
Increase lead volume by revamping landing pages and accelerating content production.
Focus on enhancing lead generation by aligning content improvements with higher quality landing pages over blogs.
Develop projections based on traffic analysis and regularly track conversion events in Google Analytics (GA4).
User Engagement Insights
Analytics show high engagement on homepage, careers, and about-us pages relative to lower engagement on blog pages.
Blogs drive considerable traffic but yield significantly lower lead conversion compared to product landing pages.
Ecommerce Optimizations
Revamp of ecommerce landing pages is scheduled to start next month with additional strategic content development.
Share and review ANZ optimized ecommerce blog topics by end of day to capture seasonal trends like Black Friday.
Market Focus Areas
Primary focus on US (including Canada) as top market, followed by Australia, with Canada as the third priority.
Technical SEO Improvements
Improve mobile performance scores from current low values (2.22) to a target above 80, as mobile traffic is prioritized.
Resolve structured data issues in ecommerce product schema to eliminate incorrect shipping cost display.
Use Google Search Console to track reindexing and schema validation issues for accurate product information.
